description: This file defines the interface and factory for the IWebAudioPlayerModuleService, which is part of the IPC layer for Web Audio Player Module in the Rialto server. It includes class declarations, method signatures for client connection management, and references to external dependencies.

classes.name: IWebAudioPlayerModuleServiceFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of IWebAudioPlayerModuleService.

classes.name: IWebAudioPlayerModuleService
classes.description: Interface for the Web Audio Player Module Service, providing methods for client connection management.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new IWebAudioPlayerModuleServiceFactory instance.

methods.name: clientConnected
methods.description: Handles logic when a client connects to the IPC service.

methods.name: clientDisconnected
methods.description: Handles logic when a client disconnects from the IPC service.
